It’s built around how studios actually run classes: recurring schedules, term structures, enrolments, and parent communication. The platform is designed for small studios and independent teachers who want to spend less time on admin and more time teaching, without needing spreadsheets, generic booking tools, or over-engineered school systems.

records.name: EasyHome
records.tagline: AI-powered home management
records.description: EasyHome with Bailey AI is the first platform that seamlessly connects your family's finances and meal planning through AI. Key Features: 🤖 AI Recipe Search - Find recipes with ingredients you already have 💰 Budget-Aware Meal Planning - Weekly plans that consider your finances 🛒 Smart Shopping Lists - AI-enhanced lists that reduce waste 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Management - Chores, points, and shared budgets

records.name: Album Del Día
records.tagline: One album a day to expand your musical horizons
records.description: Every day we select a legendary album for you to discover. Rate it, share your thoughts with the community, and build your listening streak. Get ready for a unique musical journey!

records.name: Hundredz: 100 Years of Life
records.tagline: A 100-year journal for your life story.
records.description: Hundredz is a quiet, private 100-year journal built on the belief that every life is unique. It’s born from your birth date and maps out 36,500 days in a single grid, letting you see your life as a whole. I started building it after turning 30 and realizing I couldn’t clearly remember where the last decade went — the small moments, the struggles, the growth. No streaks. No subscriptions. Your data stays on your device. I’m here to hear honest feedback.

records.name: Mergen
records.tagline: Native, lightweight SQL client. Goodbye Electron bloat.
records.description: Mergen is a next-generation, open-source SQL client built with Go and Wails. Unlike traditional tools wrapped in heavy Electron shells, Mergen utilizes the native system webview to deliver a blazing-fast experience with a tiny memory footprint (~20MB). Why Mergen? ⚡ Native Performance: Starts instantly, zero lag. 📉 Minimal Resources: Uses 90% less RAM than DataGrip or DBeaver. 🔒 Secure & Local: Built-in SSH Tunneling. No cloud sync—your data stays yours.

records.name: Bookbind
records.tagline: Strava but for reading, to cultivate readers
records.description: Bookbind is just another just another book tracker that'll get squashed by the current winners, Goodreads and The StoryGraph...or is it? While Goodreads and The StoryGraph both have book tracking features, they're emphasis is more on book recommendations & reviews, focusing on the bookshelf. Bookbind focuses on the reader, with more detailed tracking features for how the reader feels & performs each reading session. The book binding unifies the pages. Bookbind unifies reader thoughts.

records.name: AI Remover - Remove Object, BG
records.tagline: Easily remove objects, people, backgrounds, or anything.
records.description: AI-powered object erasing and background replacing, made unbelievably simple. Easily remove objects, people, backgrounds, or anything you don’t want in your photos. Our smart AI helps you find what you want to erase with just a few taps. Just tap multiple points or brush over an area to accurately identify the exact object, person, sky, or region you want. Our streamlined design ensures you get pro-level precision without complicated tools.
